textwrap — Text wrapping and filling¶

The textwrap module provides some convenience functions, as well as a class that does all the work.

textwrap.wrap(text, width=70)

Wraps the single paragraph in text so every line is at most width characters long. Returns a list of output lines, without final newlines.

Note

If the text contains tabs, they are expanded to spaces before wrapping.

See also

The string module offers other helpers for formatting text.

>>> wrap("hello world", 5)
